provenance.line_numbering: 1-based lines in the exact extracted source, not Word paragraph or PDF page numbers
provenance.rule: Canonical acceptance text is copied verbatim. Operational links and executable scenarios are handoff-derived interpretations, not additional approved clinical rules.
provenance.scope: Repository handoff only; planned implementation and unexecuted acceptance definitions.

scenario_policy: Given/When/Then scenarios operationalize the exact canonical clauses; fixture_refs remain empty until implementation authors real runnable fixtures. F01-F12 source_fixture_ids refer to the PMD scenario catalogue, not existing files. mock_scenario_ids refer only to the original synthetic mockup scenarios.
execution_policy: A scenario is PASSED only when every then-clause is asserted by tests that passed on an exact release build, with its evidence path recorded (CHG-DEV-ACC-001). A primary T-Rxx record is PASSED only when all of its scenarios are. Everything else stays NOT_EXECUTED. Historic mockup UI checks and environment/tool installation checks are not application acceptance evidence.
